FILED s531b (Opus, 2026-11-01): `prove tools/t/` (not in the Pl/t gate) is RED on main -- measured on an archive extraction of main 7a9badce and again on the s531b tree rebased onto MAIN-READY-61; s531b touches neither file.

1. tools/t/ppi-expect-check.t rows 1 5 7 9 11 12 -- 'Â§4 flagged: my $m = 7%-3;', 'Â§12 flagged: $s += length($k)*length($k);', 'Â§28 flagged: my $x = $_.2;', 'Â§25 flagged: my $z = length("abc")-length("a");', 'tools/ppi-expect-check.pl: one row for one mis-lex', 'the row: line, text, class, state, kind, Â§, primary'.  The checker no longer flags these shapes because the VENDORED PPI (vendor/PPI, branch pcl) now lexes them right (s527 batches); the test still asserts the old mis-lexes as its positives.  Fix = pick positives the vendored PPI still mis-lexes (Pl/PPIBugs.pm rows without fixed_in), or run the positives under PCL_SYSTEM_PPI=1; the controls stay.
2. tools/t/runpcl-streams.t row 14 'TAP: without $| the rows wait for exit' -- fails on main too; not investigated (stdout buffering of a TAP stream without $|).


=== s531e: HALF 1 DONE (tools/t/ppi-expect-check.t; half 2, tools/t/runpcl-streams.t row 14, is s532a's) ===
See #3980's DONE (s531e) section; commit de7d17f6.  Design chosen: the flagged shapes come from the REGISTRY (Pl/PPIBugs.pm), not a hand-written list -- so the test cannot go stale again when the next row is fixed on the branch.  tools/t/ppi-expect-check.t (commit de7d17f6): (1) every OPEN row (fixed_in undef) with a when.check kind is flagged on the vendored PPI with its kind and section, primary; its CONTROL spelling (a table keyed by section; an open row without one FAILS, so a new open row demands a control) is clean -- today §11 §19 §40 §48; (2) every row FIXED on the branch is NOT flagged on the vendored PPI (the fix and the checker agree); (3) the same fixed rows ARE flagged on the installed PPI when that is the version the row was confirmed on (a child process under PCL_SYSTEM_PPI=1 -- one process loads one PPI; skipped when no installed PPI, or another version), so every detector keeps a shape it is tested on (a kind several rows share, glob-for-multiply §12/§55, slash-as-division §11/§56, lexer-dies §6/§29, matches any of them); (4) the two tool rows use the first open row raising exactly one contradiction (today §19) plus its control.  Why not PCL_SYSTEM_PPI alone: it ties the test to an installed 1.291 that upstream may fix, and leaves the vendored lib -- what PCL runs -- untested.  12 rows -> 108, PASS (prove tools/t/ppi-expect-check.t); under PCL_SYSTEM_PPI=1 the file skips (its partition reads fixed_in 'pcl' as the vendored lib).  Found on the way: §47's repro was flagged with NO section (the generic label-not-at-statement-start rule had none) -- Pl/PPIExpect.pm now attributes it to §47 (attribution only, counts by kind unchanged).


=== DONE (s532a) ===
HALF 2 DONE (cb93dfcc, s532a): runpcl-streams.t row 14 was red EVERY run, not a flake.  Bisected: an extraction of cffd6598^ reads 'marker', of cffd6598 (s521c, #3530: Test::More's TAP through the layer's own AUTOFLUSHED dup of fd 1, as Test::Builder does) 'stdout' -- and perl itself reads 'stdout'.  The row's constant was PCL's pre-#3530 answer; it now compares against race_verdict($^X, ...) (perl's own verdict).  15/15.  Half 1 (ppi-expect-check.t) is s531e's.
